h: From the Sinai Crowns to the Crown of Salvation

p: In the Minchah prayer of Shabbos we say:
"You are One and Your Name is One."
And this will be only in the Time to Come,
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה ה׳ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד
"On that day Hashem will be One and His Name One"
וְשַׁבָּת הוּא רַק מֵעֵין עוֹלָם הַבָּא
and Shabbos is only a semblance of Olam Haba,
but the unification has not yet been revealed.
However, on Shabbos Yisrael are called
in the aspect of a bride;
and accordingly the wording was instituted
of the three prayers of Shabbos:
like a bride who requires kiddushin;
and "You are One," referring to the unification,
of the Holy One, blessed is He, and Knesses Yisrael;
"And find rest, each woman in the house of her husband."
And it is stated in the holy Zohar
to give them to Yisrael, etc.
the ornaments of the Children of Yisrael
are these gifts and presents that they received;
וּבְגִין כָּךְ לָא הֲוֵי שַׁלִּיט עֲלַיְיהוּ
and therefore there did not rule over them
either death or the Other Side, etc."
And in the Gemara (Shabbos 88a) it is stated
that the "ornaments" are the two crowns
with which they were crowned at Matan Torah,
that they took from Edom and Yishmael and their ministering angels
And it is stated (Bamidbar Rabbah 16:10, Shelach):
Esav, 'he does the will of his Maker';
For the power of Esav was the deed,
"But the hands are the hands of Esav";
who corresponded to the crown of "naaseh,"
but with Esav, "their deeds are ugly."
And although he was the dross of Yitzchak,
"You hated the blood of a person in his body."
And the power of Yishmael was hearing,
For although he was the dross of Avraham,
whose attribute was love in holiness,
for desirable things and evil lusts,
to whom the crown of "nishma" corresponds,
about the negative mitzvos, as we said;
and with him it was only "their names are fine,
the power of doing from Esav,
and the power of hearing from Yishmael.
And these are the two crowns
of which they spoke in the Gemara,
"Hashem, when You went out from Seir,
when You marched from the field of Edom."
וּבְפָסוּק זֶה לֹא נִזְכַּר רַק אֱדוֹם
And in this pasuk only Edom is mentioned,
for from Edom they took all his power for holiness,
as it will be in the Time to Come:
וְלֹא יִהְיֶה שָׂרִיד לְבֵית עֵשָׂו (עוֹבַדְיָה א, יח)
"And there shall be no survivor of the house of Esav" (Ovadiah 1:18).
This is not so with the kelipah of Yishmael,
to be the desire for the delight of Torah;
and even in the Time to Come some of it will remain,
(מִדְרַשׁ הַנֶּעְלָם תּוֹלְדוֹת, חֵלֶק א קלח, א)
"For were it not for the yetzer hara,
there would be no joy of learning;
but it will not be repulsive as at first,
And as it says there earlier (137b),
that this is why he is called Lavan:
and I created the Torah as its antidote";
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א כט, יח)
"the desire of the thoughts of the heart of Your people";
to be the desire for words of Torah,
And when they received these powers,
This is according to what is written
בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ לְמַעְלָה (חֵלֶק ג קפט, א)
that the letters ches-tes of chitah, wheat,
and that is the kelipah of Esav,
"And the house of Esav for stubble."
which is the totality of the twenty-two letters;
which is the attribute of Malchus, the mouth,
which we call Torah she'b'al peh,
to bring out the primordial light,
the aspect of the Written Torah.
And this is why it says:
"Chitah is the totality of the twenty-two letters."
the aspect of the wine of the Oral Torah,
for which the yetzer and desire were created,
to be the delight of Torah,
And this is what they said (Berachos 57a):
"Wine: there is one who drinks it and it is good for him;
there is one who drinks it and it is bad for him, etc.:
'and wine to the embittered of soul,' etc.
For a talmid chacham it is always good,
'And drink of the wine I have mixed'" (Mishlei 9:5).
is the wine of the Oral Torah
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא עֵקֶב רעא, ב)
(as is written in Ra'aya Mehemna, Eikev, III 271b).
desire was in truth created only for Torah,
that it be "drag him to the beis midrash";
and the wicked, who take the desire
are "one who drinks it and it is bad for him,"
"Whoever sets his eyes on his cup,
all forbidden relations seem to him like level ground";
and this is the kelipah of Yishmael.
And then the wine ruins the aspect of hearing,
he was drawn after them, etc.,
he read, 'Was their heart deaf,' etc."
וְתַלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים הֵם לְעוֹלָם טוֹב לוֹ
And talmidei chachamim are "it is always good for him,"
for his desire is only for words of Torah,
the place where halachos are newly derived,
which is the wine of the Oral Torah.
And when they took from them the powers
שֶׁנִּתְקַן אָז כָּל הַפְּגָם הָרִאשׁוֹן מֵהַנָּחָשׁ
for then the entire original blemish from the serpent was rectified,
of which our Sages, of blessed memory, said:
"The sin of Adam HaRishon was wheat."
the entire yetzer hara was abolished,
הוּא יֵצֶר הָרָע הוּא מַלְאַךְ הַמָּוֶת
"He is the yetzer hara, he is the Angel of Death."
But after they sinned, the crowns were removed from them,
and Moshe merited them all and took them,
as they said in the Gemara.
And regarding Shabbos, it is stated in Pri Etz Chaim
that Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
for Moshe Rabbeinu then attains his level,
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion."
And since he returns the crowns to them,
לָכֵן בְּשַׁבָּת הוּא כְּמוֹ לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא
therefore on Shabbos it is like the Time to Come,
which is the unification and the rest,
אָז הוּא אַתָּה אֶחָד וְשִׁמְךָ אֶחָד
then it is "You are One and Your Name is One."
And this is at this meal of Ze'ir Anpin,
which is the aspect of the river that goes out of Eden
down to Malchus, the aspect of Knesses Yisrael;
and then we merit the holiness of the table,
to draw down the holy spirit from above to below,
That is why we say in this prayer:
"You are One and Your Name is One,"
as it will be in the Time to Come.

is to be saved from oppression and distress.

alludes to the wine preserved in its grapes,
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
is only a revelation of a semblance of it,
שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ הִתְגַּלּוּת מֵעֵין אוֹר הָרִאשׁוֹן
in which there is a revelation of a semblance of the primordial light,
as is written in Sefer HaBahir:
and placed it for them in its stead, etc.";
and it is only to rectify the "much anger."
And this is what they said: "Wine was created only,"
meaning the aspect of wine of This World,
that is, to gladden the heart
that through it one be saved
that constricts the heart of Yisrael.
that at the first two meals of Shabbos
for one needs the cup of salvations
שֶׁעֲדַיִין לֹא עָבַר יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת בִּשְׁמִירָה
since the day of Shabbos has not yet passed in keeping it.
הַנָּהָר הַיּוֹצֵא מֵעֵדֶן לְהַשְׁקוֹת אֶת הַגָּן
the river that goes out of Eden to water the garden,
שֶׁמְּחַבֵּר מִכֶּתֶר עֶלְיוֹן עַד כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
which connects from Keser Elyon to Knesses Yisrael;
and then they are saved entirely,
as at the time of Matan Torah,
"and therefore there did not rule over them
either death or the Other Side,"
after Shabbos has passed in keeping it,
they did not institute Kiddush over wine,
for there is no need for the cup of salvations,
since they have already been saved completely,
and it is called "crown of salvation."
